title: The Landlord's Game, ancestor of Monopoly
summary: Lizzie Magie patented The Landlord's Game, a board game about land and rent, in 1904 (patent 748,626).
why: The forerunner of Monopoly, one of the world's best-selling games.

unsung.contribution: Invented and patented The Landlord's Game, the game Monopoly grew from.
unsung.recognition: Charles Darrow claimed the idea as his own; Parker Brothers credited Darrow, and Magie made about $500 and none of the credit.
